title: Backend-derived prepared image (v1)
$comment: Self-contained. A backend-specific artifact derived from a canonical weight set for one (backend, SoC, layout, build, boot, generation). The DERIVED identity binds ALL of: model_version, tensor_digest, graph_hash, backend_build, soc, arch, layout_version, boot_epoch, residency_generation. derived_image_digest = SHA-256 over the canonical-JSON of exactly those nine binding fields (recomputation checked by validate_manifests.py) so a stale-alias (a second model reusing a tensor name) can never resolve to the wrong image. gpu_plain imports the shared canonical base (derived_bytes MAY be 0, shares_canonical_base=true); gpu_xmem_prepacked and htp repack allocate a private buffer (derived_bytes>0, shares_canonical_base=false).

tensor_digest.description: content digest of the source weight set (== source_weight_set_digest)

derived_image_digest.description: SHA-256 over canonical-JSON of the nine binding fields

derived_bytes.description: backend-derived RAM, DISTINCT from canonical weight bytes
